ops.reason: Wayward Weapons is turned in at step 012 with no complete. Weapons are on the valley floor during Cutting Teeth.
ops.whyShort: Six ground spawns in the same boar field. One extra loot pass, no new camp.
ops.text: Pick up Abandoned Training Weapons off the valley floor while you kill Mottled Boars.

ops.reason: Turn-in currently happens before any weapons are looted. Move it to the Gornek hand-in after the new complete.
ops.whyShort: Kzan Thornslash is inside the Den, which the route already visits to turn in Cutting Teeth.

ops.reason: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise is turned in at step 013 with no complete.
ops.whyShort: Cactus Apples sit on the same ground as the scorpid and peon loop.
ops.text: Loot Cactus Apples from the plants around the valley while you finish the scorpid tails.

ops.reason: Turn-in sits two steps after the accept, before the player has left the Den to pick apples. Move it to after the scorpid and peon steps.
ops.whyShort: Galgar stands at the Den entrance, already on the return path.

ops.reason: Thazz'ril's Pick is accepted and turned in with no complete. The pick is in the cave on the medallion trip.
ops.whyShort: One object at the cave pool, same run as Yarrog Baneshadow.
ops.text: Grab Thazz'ril's Pick beside the pool in the Burning Blade cave before you kill Yarrog.

ops.reason: Turn-in currently follows the medallion turn-in, but the pick was never looted. Keep the turn-in after the new cave complete.
ops.whyShort: Foreman Thazz'ril is on the Den exit the route already uses.

ops.reason: Practical Prey is turned in, then Forgotten Loa Idols, Bloodtalon Matriarch, and A Pain in the Neck are still completed on the isles.
ops.whyShort: One Sen'jin visit after every isle objective, instead of a second boat trip.
ops.text: Finish idols, the matriarch egg, and the enchanting residue on the isles before any Sen'jin turn-in.

ops.reason: Complete step has no goto. The escort starts on Pal'juh inside the kolkar camp.
ops.whyShort: Same camp as the three attack plans. Escort ends at Sen'jin, which is the next turn-in anyway.

ops.reason: Complete step has no goto. Residue comes from Hexed Pendants on the Echo Isles trolls.
ops.whyShort: Same trolls as Zalazane. Only enchanters can disenchant the pendants.
ops.text: Disenchant Hexed Pendants from the isle trolls until you have three Luminous Residue. Skip this if you are not an enchanter.

ops.reason: The Orgrimmar entry pin uses Doras's indoor coordinates on the Durotar map, which lands in the Valley of Trials.
ops.whyShort: Replaces a bad pin with the grunt on the Durotar road at the city.

ops.reason: Shaman Call of Earth is done on the Felstalkers in the Burning Blade cave. The route never picks it up.
ops.whyShort: Two hooves from mobs already pulled for the medallion. Giver is beside Zureetha.
ops.text: Shamans: take Call of Earth from Canaga and loot two Felstalker hooves in the cave.

ops.reason: Follow-up after 1516. Drink the Earth Sapta at Spirit Rock before leaving the valley.
ops.whyShort: One hill south of the Den, then straight back to Canaga.
ops.text: Shamans: drink the Earth Sapta at Spirit Rock, south of the Den.

ops.reason: Closes Call of Earth. Turn the quartz in to Canaga before Report to Sen'jin.
ops.whyShort: Turn-in is the same NPC, no extra travel.
ops.text: Shamans: bring the Rough Quartz back to Canaga Earthcaller.

ops.reason: Forever breadcrumb on the barrel beside Zureetha. Prerequisite 794 is already turned in here. WoW-Pro and TUGs both take it.
ops.whyShort: One object at the quest giver the route already uses, turned in on the road to Razor Hill.
ops.text: Take the Lost Journal from the barrel beside Zureetha and bring it to Brakk on the way into Razor Hill.

ops.reason: Immediate follow-up from Brakk. Sit at his campfire for the rest buff, then turn it in on the spot.
ops.whyShort: Campfire is one step from Brakk. No kill credit.
ops.text: Sit at Brakk's campfire until the rest buff lands, then turn the quest in.

ops.reason: Troll priest breadcrumb from Ken'jai in the Den to Tai'jin in Razor Hill. The route visits both places and never takes it.
ops.whyShort: Two trainers already on the path. No kills.
ops.text: Troll priests: take In Favor of Spirituality from Ken'jai and talk to Tai'jin in Razor Hill.

ops.reason: Follow-up from Tai'jin. Heal and fortify one grunt beside Razor Hill, then hand it back.
ops.whyShort: Grunt Kor'ja is just south of the inn. Two spells and a turn-in.
ops.text: Troll priests: lesser-heal Grunt Kor'ja, buff her with Fortitude, and return to Tai'jin.

ops.reason: Shaman level-10 breadcrumb from Swart. The route already passes the Razor Hill trainers and leaves toward the Barrens on 840.
ops.whyShort: One accept. The kill chain starts in the Barrens, not here.
ops.text: Shamans: accept Call of Fire from Swart. Turn it in to Kranal Fiss in the Barrens with the conscript handoff.

sources.label: QuestieDB NPC 3173 spawn, zone 14; NPC 5907 is Barrens map 1413

ops.reason: Burning Shadows starts from the eye that cultists drop in Skull Rock. The route already clears that cave for 827 and 5726 and then visits Neeru.
ops.whyShort: Same cave, same Orgrimmar turn-in as Neeru Fireblade. No extra camp.
ops.text: If a Burning Blade cultist drops the eye, accept Burning Shadows and hand it to Neeru with the Skull Rock report.

sources.label: QuestieDB quest 832 item start; Neeru 3216 at 49.5, 50.6 in Orgrimmar

ops.reason: Lost But Not Forgotten is a rare crocolisk drop along the river, then a return to the farm. Free guides include it. Cut the whole quest.
ops.whyShort: Removing it deletes a low drop-rate lap. Nothing later in this route requires 816.

sources.label: QuestieDB quest 816, no follow-up in this route

ops.reason: Need for a Cure applies a damaging poison and forces an Orgrimmar cure. Cut it together with 813.
ops.whyShort: Skipping Rhinag avoids the poison and the cure trip. No later quest needs 812.

ops.reason: Finding the Antidote is the cure for 812. Questie gives it no XP. It is a venom-sac collection and two city trips.
ops.whyShort: Drops with 812. The route no longer needs the sacs.

ops.reason: A Simmering Storm is looted from the harpies, then the route turns it in and comes back again for Securing the Lines.
ops.whyShort: One Rezlak visit can turn in both quests.
ops.text: Loot the Dull Stormy Orb while you kill the harpies, then turn in Securing the Lines and A Simmering Storm together.
